title: Kando (感動): A Cognitive-Load-Aware, Multilingual Architecture for Spaced Retrieval and Immersion-Driven Japanese Language Acquisition
description: Second-language acquisition (SLA) for non-cognate logographic languages—specifically Japanese across JLPT N5 through N1—suffers from high learner attrition. Kando Japanese (感動) introduces a full-stack, distributed pedagogical architecture synthesizing Krashen's Comprehensible Input (i+1) with a 250-story tiered Graded Reader (Tadoku), an interactive SVG vector-decomposition Kanji stroke engine (831 Joyo Kanji), a timezone-normalized SuperMemo SM-2 spaced repetition algorithm with intensity scheduling, and a contextual multi-LLM pedagogical companion (Sensei 3D) with deterministic semantic guardrails across 12 UI locales including Tamil and Hindi.
